========================================================================
             HUONG DAN CAI DAT VIET HOA: MARK OF THE DEEP
             Phien ban ho tro: v2.3.6 (UE5)  |  Ban dich: v1.0.0
            Thuc hien boi: Diiexe (https://github.com/diiexe)
   [MIEN PHI 100%] Neu ban phai tra tien mua ban dich nay la bi lua dao
========================================================================

1. CACH CAI DAT TU DONG (KHUYEN DUNG):
   - Buoc 1: Giai nen file MarkOfTheDeep_VietHoa_v1.0.0.zip ra bat ky dau.
   - Buoc 2: Nhap dup chay file "CaiDat_VietHoa.bat".
   - Buoc 3: Nhap phim "1" (hoac nhan Enter).
     + Neu script tu dong tim thay thu muc game cua ban, chi can nhan
       Enter de cai dat ngay.
     + Neu ban cai game o vi tri khac, hay copy va dan duong dan thu muc
       game vao cua so CMD roi nhan Enter.
   - Buoc 4: Mo game va thuong thuc Tieng Viet!

2. CACH CAI DAT THU CONG:
   - Copy file "pakchunk0-VietHoa_P.pak" dan vao thu muc:
     <Thu_Muc_Game>\MarkOfTheDeep\Content\Paks\~mods\
     (Tu tao thu muc ~mods neu chua co).

3. CACH GO BO (KHOI PHUC GAME GOC 100%):
   - Chay file "GoCaiDat_VietHoa.bat" (hoac chay "CaiDat_VietHoa.bat"
     va chon "2"), hoac xoa file "pakchunk0-VietHoa_P.pak" trong ~mods.

4. TU CHINH SUA BAN DICH (DANH CHO NGUOI MUON SUA TEXT):
   - Truy cap kho ma nguon tren GitHub, sua file:
     src/translated_text/vi_strings.json
   - Chay lenh: python src/tools/build_mod.py

5. LUU Y:
   - Ban dich duoc thuc hien bang AI phuc vu nhu cau ca nhan, chia se
     cho ai can thi dung, dung duoc thi dung khong thi thoi nhe.
   - Ban mod chi nap ngon ngu va font chu qua ~mods, chia se nguyen
     trang khong bao hanh; nguoi chia se khong chiu trach nhiem neu
     phat sinh loi game hay bat ky van de nao khac khi su dung.
========================================================================
